data.title: Implement cosmetic blocking [tracking]
data.body:
So I have enabled the cosmetic filtering option over brave://flags. But as soon as I visit a website, brave nightly crashes on Windows 10. I also cannot find any additional option concerning cosmetic filtering in the brave settings after relaunch after I enabled the flag.

Is there something I have missed to enable this option?

data.title: Implement cosmetic blocking [tracking]
data.body:
@szaimen crashes on Windows should be fixed as of https://github.com/brave/brave-core/pull/4540.

Currently there are no additional settings regarding cosmetic filtering; this work supports the cosmetic filters that will soon be shipped from our filter lists.
